limits: The installed wheel only carries LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial.txt in dist-info. These files supplement it; existing wheel notices are preserved.
A fresh ordinary QWebEnginePage could not open chrome://credits/ or qtwebengine://qtwebengine-credits/. The official 6.140 WebUI factory also has no credits route.
WebEngine notices are the official 6.140 documentation corpus, not a successful binary-embedded credits export and not a proven platform-specific bill of materials.
No public v6.140.0 Git tag was available during retrieval. WebEngine source license files are pinned to the recorded 6.140 branch commit; exact correspondence to the wheel build is not established.
